svg.title: The life of a file in a claimed project
svg.desc: A file of yours before a claim; after projects claim it moves to the sandbox group and loses world access; a file the coding agent writes is born owned by the sandbox account and you reach it through your grant; the handback returns it to you, or to you and your group alone when its name is a secret's; after projects unclaim a handed-back file is back in your group, the coding agent has no access and world access does not return.

svg.text: · a file you wrote is not re-owned by the handback: it acts only while the coding agent owns a file
